phrase.zh: 月面的明暗，记录漫长的变化。
phrase.en: Light and dark mark the Moon’s long history.

visual.zh: 环形坑、断层般的边缘与深色平原在画面中相接，把月面看作保存痕迹的地质表面。地形组合并非真实月球区域的地图。
visual.en: Craters, fault-like edges and dark plains meet in an imagined lunar landscape. Their arrangement is not a map of any real region.

background.zh: 月面的撞击坑记录了小天体的撞击。深色的“月海”不是海水，而是熔岩在古老撞击盆地中铺展并冷却形成的玄武岩平原。
background.en: Impact craters record collisions with smaller bodies. The dark lunar “maria” are not seas of water; they are basaltic plains formed when lava spread across old impact basins and cooled.
